about: Cells of test/lint-redteam.test.mjs that go against what they should do today. Under a rule, a carrier is a shape the planted mistake arrived in that the rule did not report, or a control it reported that it should have left alone (the local look-alike, another package's part or a shadowing parameter, by the rule's family). Under escape checks, a route that no ledger rule and no count sees. The list only shrinks: when the test says a cell is caught, delete its entry (scripts/check-allow-lists.mjs compares with the base branch).
